{"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.affix.cangye-cut-pursuit","name":"截追","kind":"affix","scope":"equipment","version":3,"description":"藏夜击伤活敌，并由显形收割真正消耗一枚旧雷痕后，使该敌人的主动移动速度降低词条所示比例，持续1.2秒。首击无旧雷时不触发，后段新雷只供以后接触。不改攻击动作、击退位移，也不要求敌人低血。同名取最强，较弱的不续时。","iconGuid":"d693a610-5c43-559b-b645-f9c6a4d96b0a","families":["control.consumed-thunder-pursuit"],"mechanism":{"kind":"affix","parameters":{"stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"player","modules":["returning-sword"],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["atlas-s32"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"module-gated","moduleEvidence":"藏夜截追私有耗雷词；装备准备核验本器、效果身份、原词值与消费工序。"},"eligibility":{"id":"affix.roll.cangye-cut-pursuit","name":"截追","systems":["returning-sword"],"introducedInPoolVersion":3,"definitionVersion":1,"balanceVersion":1,"comparableRuleVersion":1,"ownerEquipmentId":"atlas-s32","slot":"suffix","unit":"percent","stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","visualSignal":"rune","consumer":{"capability":"sword-tuning","version":4},"recordPolicy":"higher","allowedKinds":["weapon"],"poolKinds":["weapon"],"poolFamilies":["returning-melee"],"scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"minRarity":3,"minimumItemLevel":1,"selectionWeight":0.9,"budgetCost":10,"maximumEffectiveValue":0.08,"conflicts":[],"contactStatus":{"statusId":"cangye-cut-pursuit","trigger":"consumed-status","consumedStatusId":"thunder-mark"}}}},"strength":[{"field":"value","label":"敌人主动移速降低比例","formula":{"kind":"affix-range","definitionId":"affix.roll.cangye-cut-pursuit","baseValue":0.035,"valuePerTier":0.003,"operation":"increased","unit":"降低比例（0.035表示主动移速乘0.965）","levels":{"min":1,"max":100,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[{"targetId":"effect.affix.cangye-harvest-ward","weight":0.1,"reason":"同次旧雷收割可给目标截追和本词不同端点，互不为前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cangye-harvest-step","weight":0.1,"reason":"同次旧雷收割可给目标截追和本词不同端点，互不为前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cangye-sunder-cadence","weight":0.1,"reason":"同次旧雷收割可给目标截追和本词不同端点，互不为前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cangye-kill-clarity","weight":0,"reason":"本次致死与仍活目标后续截追不同，不因同剑泛加权。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.tinglv-thunder-guard","weight":0,"reason":"藏夜截追不替霆律耗雷；减速与护持无额外共享比例。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.continuous-returning-strike","weight":0.6,"reason":"藏夜主击可先收旧雷再续印，首击或失印仍不能截追；不是每击必控。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.revealed-target-harvest","weight":1,"reason":"实际收割旧雷是截追直接凭据；只读成功消费，不另收一次接触费或雷痕。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.seek-back-row","weight":0.3,"reason":"后排选择能接近追赶来源，却不优先保证旧雷；截追不能凭索敌补上前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s29.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.35,"reason":"逐电可补首次接触前的雷痕；藏夜也能自行续印，外供不是持续必需。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s23.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.28,"reason":"鎏炎留下的雷可补藏夜初击，后道耗火不应误算为对雷的消费。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s24.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.25,"reason":"汽焰锁真正刻雷能补首击前置；破膜、水膜不是截追的耗雷凭据。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s26.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.2,"reason":"沸潮真实留雷可被后续收割，无膜照样可供；其破膜与截追不关联。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s28.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.15,"reason":"归炉留下的雷可能供后排收割，其他五行工序不提高截追条件概率或强度。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.55,"reason":"本器后道新雷只支持以后接触；不能倒补同击前段，且会被其他剑抢印。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.thunder-mark","weight":0.45,"reason":"真正存在并被本器消费的旧雷是必要前置；状态本身不提高减速词值或持续时间。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.cangye-cut-pursuit","weight":1,"reason":"实际截追词值只产生一份私有减速，受体不再刻雷、攻击或生成后缀。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s02.marked-vibration-cut","weight":0.05,"reason":"鸣律会抢先耗掉旧雷，属于竞争；不因为也耗雷便获取藏夜私有截追。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.metal-lattice-flame","weight":0.05,"reason":"金笼焰束焰只消费旧雷，会让藏夜少一次截追前置；不能当供应工序。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s30.marked-vibration-cut","weight":0.05,"reason":"霆律振切同样只耗旧雷，可能先拿走收割条件；敛震不能供雷给截追。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.low-target-health-execution","weight":0,"reason":"截追只要求真耗旧雷与存活受体，不要求低血；致死斩杀反而没有受体。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.quick-withdrawal","weight":0.4,"reason":"截追缓慢敌人主动追赶，轻撤加快主人翻滚恢复；敌我不同受体形成撤身互补。"}]},"designNotes":["截追词最低品质R3、物等1、预算10，藏夜载体仍最低R3；词条资格不改写载体门槛。","藏夜先显形收割旧雷，再导电刻印新雷。首次接触没有旧雷时只会刻雷，后段的新雷不能倒补前段的成功消费凭据。","以后接触只有旧雷仍在、收割实际移除旧雷、真正扣血且目标还活着，才施加截追；被别剑抢印或旧雷过期时不触发。","显形收割与低血斩杀是独立工序；高血敌人可受截追，致死接触没有存活受体，不用斩杀条件冒充触发前置。","无雷、零伤、无敌、只撞盾、致死、非接触和状态tick不触发；真实零伤接触声音保持原规则。","物等L的中点m(L)=0.035+0.0003(L−1)，普通范围0.8m至1.2m；L1为2.8%–4.2%，L100为5.176%–7.764%，8%是执行上限。","原词值x直接作为modifierStrength，由more端点0得到1−x，不重复乘8%上限；固定1.2秒，不随状态时长加成延长。","只改活敌主动moveSpeed，沿现有导航意图比例传给走路和飞行；不改actionRate、攻击间隔、受击硬直或强制击退。","不提高标准木桩DPS或主人无条件承伤，不新增战斗VFX、逐敌计时器、状态层数或固定步关系查询。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s32","effects","attributes"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s32","name":"藏夜"}},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s32/effects/attributes/affix.cangye-cut-pursuit/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s32/effects/attributes/affix.cangye-cut-pursuit/item-affix.pack.ts","src/weapon-arsenal/contact-status-affix.ts","src/combat/sword-contact-status.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts","docs/design/proposals/FOUR-SWORD-CONTROL-AND-WARD-SUFFIX-PLAN.md"],"legacyNodeIds":[]}}}
